name: New Hampshire

office.name: NHDOT Oversize and Overweight Permit Office (Bureau of Highway Maintenance, Concord)

fees.note: RSA 266:22 I: $6 per permit for over-length, over-width, over-height or any combination. Valid 5 business days (10 for round trip).

RSA 266:22 II: by vehicle+load weight - 80,001-90,000 $9.50; 90,001-100,000 $10.50; +$2 per additional 10,000 lb (tiers listed through 200,001-210,000 = $32.50; heavier loads add $2 per further 10,000 lb, not modeled). Supermoves (>149,999 lb) may also need a PE engineering report at applicant's expense.

police.text: 1 police escort. Length 100' or more: 1 State Police escort unless State Police waive based on conditions
2 police escorts. Width over 14': total of 2 State Police escorts (includes the one for length >= 100'); 3 if any road closure is needed

restrictions.text: Oversize (or OS+OW) moves: daylight only (1/2 hr before sunrise to 1/2 hr after sunset); not valid on weekends. Supermove permits set their own dates/times.

Permits not valid on New Year's, MLK Day, Presidents' Day, Memorial Day, July 4, Labor Day, Columbus Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving + the following Friday, Christmas; holiday on Sunday also restricts Monday, on Saturday also restricts Friday. Overweight-only loads at normal traffic speed are exempt from date/time limits.
No movement during inclement weather (fog, heavy rain, freezing rain, sleet, ice, snow, wind); no convoys; must pull over when 7+ vehicles queue behind.

travel.weekends: No travel on Saturday or Sunday
travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend
travel.note: NH also closes MLK, Presidents', Columbus and Veterans Day and the day after Thanksgiving (not modeled).

sources.title: N.H. Admin. Rules Tra 304 - Oversize and Overweight Vehicle Permits
NH RSA Chapter 266 (266:10 height, 266:11 length, 266:12 width, 266:18 weight, 266:22 permit fees)

notes: Permits cover only the NH state highway system; local roads need town/city approval. Permits issued under the New England Transportation Consortium (NETC) agreement are honored in NH without a separate NH permit.
Every load over 13'6" high is a supermove in NH (single-trip permit not issued) and requires a physical route survey and PE-certified engineering report - expect long lead time.

Non-police escort for width is defined for 12' to <14'; over 14' the rule calls for 2 State Police escorts instead. The calculator still counts the non-police escort for >14' (possible over-count) - permit office may require both.
If the engine sums police counts, a load >= 100' long and > 14' wide shows 3; the rule total is 2 (3 only with road closure).
Divisible-load and non-interstate gross weights up to 99,000 lb require RSA 266:18-d certification; calculator uses 80,000 lb legal gross.
